_about: Hand-written ground truth for a stratified sample of the Red Herring Prospectus.
Each record names a source block by a unique opening anchor; build_gold.py pulls the
block text out of the PDF and resolves these labels to character offsets, so the
labels below are the only hand-authored part and transcription errors are impossible.
Labelling policy (mirrors README, 'Precision choices we made deliberately'):
* Company/registration identifiers (CIN, SEBI registration no., firm registration
no.) are NOT PII - they identify a filing, not a person.
* Names of regulators and exchanges (SEBI, BSE, NSE, Registrar of Companies) are NOT
labelled as ORGANIZATION; they are public bodies, not private parties.
* A physical address IS labelled even when it belongs to a public office.
* A bare city or state ('Pune', 'Maharashtra') is NOT an address on its own.
* 'occurrence' is 1-based and defaults to 1; whitespace in 'text' matches flexibly.
